goals: Reduce risk of data corruption while improving maintainability and UX
Refactor logic.py monolith safely using a facade/strangler approach
Improve performance incrementally with caching and safer ID generation
Add baseline automated tests to prevent regressions

no_data_corruption_rules: Create DB + images snapshot before any write-path change
Wrap all write operations in transactions; rollback on error
Run smoke test after every commit
Do not enforce schema constraints until tests exist and backfill reports are clean

before_any_write_path_change: Manual backup created from Settings UI
before_any_schema_migration: Rollback verified: restore DB + checkout tag

phases.name: Safety Setup
phases.objective: Add recovery points and fast validation to prevent corruption

tasks.title: Create timestamped snapshot (DB + images)
steps: Stop the app
Copy atelier.db -> snapshots/YYYYMMDD_HHMM/atelier.db
If dress_images/ exists, copy to snapshots/YYYYMMDD_HHMM/dress_images/
Start the app and create a manual backup from Settings UI
acceptance_criteria: Manual backup exists in backups/ (or configured backup directory)
rollback: Restore dress_images/ from snapshot if needed

tasks.title: Add smoke test script (read-only)
implementation_notes: Import app module without starting server
Open SQLAlchemy session and run count queries for core tables
Exit code 0 on success; non-zero on failure

tasks.title: Repo hygiene: .gitignore + .env.example + .editorconfig
steps: Ignore backups/, releases/, atelier.db, dress_images/
Add .env.example documenting APP_ENV, APP_DEBUG, APP_SECRET_KEY, APP_BACKUP_RETENTION_COUNT, DATABASE_URL (optional)
Add .editorconfig to normalize line endings to LF
acceptance_criteria: git status does not track db/backups/images
Line endings normalize in future commits

phases.name: Integrity Fixes (Non-admin)
phases.objective: Fix user-save corruption risk without touching admin-password behavior

tasks.title: Fix save_users_data() delete-all pattern with transactional upsert
steps: Locate save_users_data()
Start a DB transaction
For each user row: update existing by id/username or insert new
Do not delete all users; keep deletions as explicit separate action
On any exception: rollback and surface error
acceptance_criteria: Forced exception mid-save leaves users unchanged (rollback)

tasks.title: Remove dead code only if unreferenced
steps: Identify dead code stubs flagged in review
Search for references before deletion
Remove only if truly unused
Run smoke test

phases.name: UX Improvements (Feature-flagged)
phases.objective: Ship low-risk UX upgrades behind APP_UX_V2

tasks.title: Introduce APP_UX_V2 feature flag
steps: Read APP_UX_V2 from environment
Gate new UX elements behind the flag
Default flag off

tasks.title: Make dropdowns searchable
steps: Set searchable=True on all dcc.Dropdown components

tasks.title: Replace date text inputs with DatePickerSingle (no storage format change)
steps: Add DatePickerSingle inputs for relevant date fields
Add centralized conversion helpers: ui_date_to_storage / storage_to_ui_date
Keep DB representation unchanged for this phase
Handle None/empty safely

tasks.title: Add save success toast/snackbar
steps: Add toast component
Trigger toast on successful save operations

tasks.title: Add booking status field (soft default)
steps: Add status in UI and persist for new records
Default missing status to 'Active' in read path
Do not enforce DB constraints yet
acceptance_criteria: Existing bookings show 'Active' when status missing

phases.name: Maintainability: Split logic.py safely
phases.objective: Reduce monolith risk with facade/strangler pattern (behavior unchanged)
phases.strategy: Create app/domain modules; move one domain at a time; keep logic.py API stable via re-exports

tasks.title: Create app/domain skeleton
steps: Create modules with placeholders only (no behavior change)

tasks.title: Move auth helpers to app/domain/auth.py; re-export from logic.py
steps: Move password hashing/verification and auth-related helpers
In logic.py: from app.domain.auth import <functions>
Keep signatures unchanged

tasks.title: Move customers CRUD to app/domain/customers.py; re-export
steps: Move add/update/delete customer and validation
Keep existing behaviors unchanged (including name-based linking for now)
Re-export from logic.py

tasks.title: Move dresses logic to app/domain/dresses.py; re-export
steps: Move dress CRUD and image save helpers
Re-export from logic.py

tasks.title: Move bookings logic to app/domain/bookings.py; re-export
steps: Move booking CRUD and calculations
Keep ID generation behavior unchanged until P4
Re-export from logic.py

tasks.title: Move payments logic to app/domain/payments.py; re-export
steps: Move payment CRUD and validation
Re-export from logic.py

tasks.title: Reduce logic.py to thin facade (<200 lines target)
steps: Remove duplicated implementations already moved
Keep only imports/re-exports and shared tiny helpers

phases.name: Performance + Data Integrity (Incremental)
phases.objective: Improve scaling and prepare safe migrations

tasks.title: Replace sequential ID full scans with SELECT MAX(id) aggregate query
steps: Replace any 'load all rows then max()' with aggregate max query
Add basic uniqueness guard for single-process usage
acceptance_criteria: IDs remain unique in normal usage

tasks.title: Implement TTL cache for load_data() with invalidation on writes
steps: Add in-memory cache per entity with timestamps
TTL default 2 seconds
Invalidate relevant keys after create/update/delete

tasks.title: Add pytest baseline (unit + integration)
steps: Add pytest + pytest-cov
Add SQLite in-memory fixtures
Add unit tests for hashing/phone/money validation
Add integration test: booking -> payment linkage and totals

tasks.title: Backfill scripts for FK readiness (no enforcement yet)
steps: Generate backfill mapping from customer_name to customer_id
Update bookings with missing customer_id
Produce unresolved report (CSV/JSON)
Do not enforce NOT NULL / FK in this task

per_commit_checks: Launch app and verify login + one CRUD screen
If booking/payment touched: verify finance totals on known dataset
